claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu defines density as an individual or group’s level of consciousness and perception, rather than a physical location or measurable frequency.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Her definition rejects fixed numbered locations.

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu says higher consciousness involves understanding others’ perspectives with empathy, while denying any absolute spiritual hierarchy.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari Swaruu argues that chronic fear-based overthinking can keep a person focused on material survival and hinder spiritual growth.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She distinguishes hypothetical worry from real danger requiring caution.

review_flags: The source gives a metaphysical account of consciousness and spiritual development, retained as speaker attribution.
